response.sql: WITH matched_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.recordvault, o.timespan FROM orders o INNER JOIN riskandmargin rm ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault), timespan_counts AS (SELECT timespan, COUNT(*) as distinct_order_count FROM matched_orders GROUP BY timespan), with_totals AS (SELECT timespan, distinct_order_count, SUM(distinct_order_count) OVER () as total_orders, COUNT(*) OVER () as num_timespans FROM timespan_counts) SELECT timespan, distinct_order_count, CAST(distinct_order_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(total_orders AS DECIMAL) as share, (CAST(distinct_order_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(total_orders AS DECIMAL)) - (1 / CAST(num_timespans AS DECIMAL)) as diff_from_avg FROM with_totals ORDER BY timespan
